snippet.title: Mortal Shell II - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Their Flesh Is Your Weapon. Coming to Steam, PS5 and Xbox in 2026.

Mortal Shell II is a standalone sequel action-RPG with adrenaline-charged, high-stakes combat. 

Possess warrior Shells, dethrone false gods, redeem a ravaged world.

Beta sign-ups: http://www.mortalshell.com
